core_obligations: Since dim Lambda_q = 0 the ideal q Lambda_q is nilpotent, so some power of h_A dies: pick lambda not in q with lambda (h_A)^N = 0 in Lambda.
The delocalize-weak lemma gives a finitely presented factorization A -> C -> Lambda with singular ideal h_C not inside q.
Construct B = A[x_1, ..., x_n, y_1, ..., y_r, z, t_{ij}]/(f_j - sum y_i t_{ij}, z y_i) with its displayed map to Lambda sending z to lambda and y_i to the image of a_i^N.

Check smoothness on the standard opens: B_z is isomorphic to C[y, z, z^{-1}] and hence smooth, and B_{y_l} is isomorphic to a polynomial algebra over A, hence smooth; conclude z and a_l y_l lie in H_{B/R}, so every prime over q contains H_{B/R}, i.e. B resolves the situation.
proof_roadmap: Nilpotence of the height-zero prime; delocalized factorization; spread construction; smoothness on opens.
difficulty_reason: A four-step construction; the substance is the explicit B and the two standard-open smoothness checks, both carried.
